title: Mask Adoption Diffusion Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior spreads and persists in a population under social influence, policy interventions, and supply constraints.

interactions.name: social_influence
interactions.description: People observe mask use among network neighbors and at locations; their pro-mask attitude and adoption probability adjust based on observed prevalence and peer communications.

interactions.name: policy_mandate_effect
interactions.description: Mandates and enforcement from the authority increase perceived cost of noncompliance and raise compliance among persons at locations.

interactions.name: enforcement_interaction
interactions.description: Inspections at locations lead to fines or denial of entry for noncompliant persons, affecting future compliance and attitude.

interactions.name: supply_purchase
interactions.description: Persons purchase masks from suppliers subject to stock and price; households can allocate inventory to members.

interactions.name: information_campaign
interactions.description: Policy authority and media sources broadcast messages that adjust risk perception and trust, influencing adoption.

interactions.name: norm_observation
interactions.description: Observed mask prevalence at locations updates individuals' perceived social norms and subsequent behavior.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Fraction of people wearing a mask each day.

metrics.name: peak_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Maximum daily fraction of mask wearers observed during the simulation.

metrics.name: time_to_majority_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days until at least 50% of the population wears masks.

metrics.name: sustained_adoption_rate_last_14_days
metrics.description: Average adoption rate over the final 14 days, indicating persistence.

metrics.name: noncompliance_rate_under_mandate
metrics.description: Fraction of individuals not wearing masks while a mandate is active.

metrics.name: inequality_index_by_income
metrics.description: Disparity in adoption across socioeconomic groups, e.g., Gini or difference in rates.

metrics.name: mask_shortage_days
metrics.description: Count of days any supplier experiences zero stock.

metrics.name: campaign_effect_size
metrics.description: Difference-in-differences in adoption attributable to information campaigns or mandates.

validation_criteria.name: convergence_stability
validation_criteria.description: Change in adoption rate is below 0.01 per day over the last 14 days.

validation_criteria.name: s_curve_fit
validation_criteria.description: Adoption trajectory fits a logistic curve with R^2 >= 0.8 over the growth period.

validation_criteria.name: no_negative_inventory
validation_criteria.description: Supplier stock levels remain non-negative throughout the simulation.

validation_criteria.name: majority_by_target_day_optional
validation_criteria.description: If a target_majority_day parameter is provided, simulated majority adoption occurs within +/- 7 days of the target.
